subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should this PR become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106379 instead of the overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405?
rationale: Both pull requests are proof-positive and now implement substantially the same recovery contract, but maintainers must select one code shape to avoid landing duplicate projection paths.

options.title: Land this narrower patch
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, rerun exact-head service proof, and close the overlapping pull request after this implementation lands.

options.title: Land the overlapping patch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 if owners prefer its existing-pruning-path implementation, then close this PR as superseded.

options.title: Consolidate both approaches
options.body: Pause both branches and create a single owner-directed patch if neither helper boundary matches the desired long-term Gateway structure.

recommendation.title: Land this narrower patch
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, rerun exact-head service proof, and close the overlapping pull request after this implementation lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the safe-mode contract introduced by their crash-loop circuit-breaker work.
